boundary_condition: Use JetBlue as a tie-breaker among viable flight options; do not override explicit timing, route, cabin, or current-search carrier constraints.
condition: When searching for flights and choosing among airline options for a specific trip.
default_action: Look for JetBlue options first and select or recommend JetBlue when it otherwise satisfies the trip constraints.
exception_condition: If JetBlue is unavailable or materially worse on required trip constraints, offer other acceptable airlines instead of insisting on JetBlue.
name: Prefers JetBlue flights when available
preference_value: JetBlue as a preferred, non-exclusive airline
rationale: The cited examples repeatedly identify JetBlue as preferred or selected, while one example lists JetBlue among several acceptable preferred airlines. This supports a reusable synthetic default to favor JetBlue, but not an exclusive-carrier rule.
